name: Service to the Horde
summary: The jeweled pendant now sits with Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar, delivered after Report to Zor, and Zor has one more word for you.

sections.title: Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar
sections.body: You carried the jeweled pendant to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar, and the pendant now sits with Zor. Return to Zor Lonetree and there is more to hear about what you have done for the Horde.

sections.title: Zor's Last Word
sections.body: Zor says the scholars will need time to study the pendant. For your service to the Horde, Zor offers a small token, and says that what you have done brings honor to you and to the Horde.

faq.answer: Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar, after you carried it there from Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
It follows Report to Zor, where you took the jeweled pendant to Zor Lonetree.
